teaser: A joke lands exactly when it should, and the room laughs before you finish the sentence. A ledger gets checked twice before you let yourself enjoy that laugh. Life path 3 asks for voice — the wit, the color, the need to be heard — and ISTJ holds the pen steady, checks the facts, waits for the right moment instead of chasing the big one. You are a 3 who counts before speaking and speaks only once the count feels right. What comes of the two together is practiced spontaneity: charm that has been proofread, warmth delivered on schedule, whether anyone asked for it that way or not.
excerpt: The hotel lobby with the elevator button that only half-lights waits while you check the itinerary twice before anyone else is awake.
